title: 09. Trace route, method, and record dispatch

examples.explanation: `GET /items` lists all items, sorted by id.
`DELETE` returns 204. A later `GET` of the same item returns 404.
`POST` is not allowed on `/items/9`: 405 with the allowed methods. The method is checked before the item lookup.

hints: Resolve the route before checking its method.
Copy each response representation before later mutations.
